note: CVBench questions Qwen3.8-27B answers WITHOUT video in >= 3 of 4 seeds in BOTH option orders (O1 as released, O2 reversed). 'thinking' = effort medium, T 0.6; 'no_thinking' = thinking off. both_modes / either_mode combine the two legs; either_mode is the conservative deletion set for video claims. Caution: on yes/no questions the answer is a word, so reversing the options cannot catch a Yes/No habit; the yes/no passes are not above the model's own Yes/No habit (docs/cvbench_text_only.md, section 3.2). Filter on format to keep only the lettered questions. The O2 order moves the 'All/None of the above' option of 47 questions and the 'Both A and C' option of cvb-89, so those 48 questions are flagged in o2_position_dependent. The no_thinking columns come from the rerun with per-call seeds (_q38nt2), which replaced the as-run control (_q38nt), whose batched calls shared one noise stream per batch slot.
